recognize_zh: 這是細胞遺傳學影像：一個經數位處理（去背景、增強對比）的中期分裂相，染色體延長且散開、帶紋清楚，是後續排列成核型圖之前的步驟，本身無法直接判讀異常。
features: Single GTG-banded metaphase spread after digital processing (background removed, contrast enhanced)
Chromosomes are relatively long and well spread with discernible light and dark bands, suitable for karyotyping
A few chromosomes overlap near the center, which must be separated during karyogram assembly
No numerical or structural abnormality can be reliably assessed before the chromosomes are arranged
describe_en: This is a cytogenetic image rather than a morphologic smear, showing a single GTG-banded metaphase from a cultured bone marrow aspirate after digital processing to remove background and enhance banding. The chromosomes are well spread and elongated with visible banding, although some overlap centrally. Such processed metaphases are subsequently cut out and arranged into a karyogram by length, centromere position and banding pattern for counting and structural analysis. No abnormality can be interpreted from the unarranged spread alone.
